title: Aequitas Flow: Streamlining Fair ML Experimentation
reasoning: The paper presents Aequitas Flow, a technical toolkit and framework for measuring and mitigating algorithmic bias in machine learning models. While it focuses on fairness and includes 'ethical artificial intelligence' as a keyword, it benchmarks statistical fairness metrics and mitigation algorithms on tabular data rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, moral reasoning, or ethical systems themselves.
